facts.business: Shilpa Medicare Limited is an Indian pharmaceutical company engaged in the development and manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Finished Dosage Formulations, with a focus on oncology, peptides, Antibody-Drug Conjugate (ADC) technologies, and novel therapies like NorUDCA for NAFLD and OERIS™ for CINV.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to large number of customers across geographies with varying contract terms and timing of transfer of control

Impairment risk on investments and loans to subsidiaries, associates and joint ventures (Rs. 1,227.5 crore as at March 31, 2026) due to estimation uncertainty in recoverable amounts based on discounted cash flow forecasts
facts.related_party_note: CSR expenditure of Rs. 93 lakhs in FY26 (Rs. 133 lakhs in FY25) transferred to 'Shilpa Foundation', a related party trust.
